categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Hotgen Biotech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the biotechnological sector focusing on in vitro diagnostics (IVD) reagents and instruments, and biopharmaceutical innovation drugs. The company develops products and solutions spanning early disease screening, diagnosis, and treatment, with strategic investments in biopharmaceutical companies specializing in antibody and nucleic acid drugs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary core technologies including phage display large-capacity fully synthetic human antibody preparation, glycan capture technology for liquid biopsy, magnetic microparticle chemiluminescence, upconversion luminescence (UPT) technology, and rapid fluorescent PCR. Production methods emphasize automation, high throughput, and precision, supported by ISO9001, ISO13485, and other international quality standards, with ongoing innovation in AI-driven drug discovery platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hotgen serves clinical diagnostic laboratories, hospitals (from grassroots to tertiary), health management centers, and public safety sectors. Its products target markets in liver disease, cancer early screening, cardiovascular and neurological diseases, and public safety testing including drug abuse and food safety. The company also targets international markets through its subsidiaries and exports.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Beijing and production bases in Langfang and Shenzhen. It has subsidiaries and sales operations in India, Hong Kong, and the United States, with growing international market penetration, especially in Europe and Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hotgen operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the biotechnology supply chain, focusing on R&D, manufacturing, and sales of diagnostic reagents, instruments, and biopharmaceutical products. It is expanding upstream capabilities by developing and producing core biological raw materials to reduce costs and enhance control over supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in diagnostic technologies and biopharmaceuticals, focusing on early disease detection and treatment solutions. Key R&D directions include advancing glycan capture liquid biopsy platforms, chemiluminescence and upconversion luminescence technologies, AI-driven drug discovery, and development of first-in-class and best-in-class antibody and nucleic acid drugs. It also emphasizes clinical validation, regulatory approvals, and expanding product pipelines in oncology, cardiovascular, and neurological diseases.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of in vitro diagnostic reagents, instruments, and biological raw materials. The company employs a combined sales model of direct sales and distribution, with distribution being the dominant channel. Additional income arises from investment returns, licensing, and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hotgen positions itself as a leading domestic innovator in the Chinese IVD and biopharmaceutical sectors, competing with multinational corporations like Roche, Abbott, Beckman, and Siemens in clinical diagnostics. It differentiates through proprietary technologies and a comprehensive product portfolio covering full diagnostic scenarios. The company is recognized for its innovation in glycan capture and upconversion luminescence technologies and is expanding its footprint in biopharmaceutical innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hotgen reported revenues of approximately RMB 510.9 million, a slight decline compared to the previous year, mainly due to reduced non-routine testing business. The company invested heavily in R&D, with expenditures accounting for 22.18% of revenue. Despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 191 million, the company maintains a strong asset base of over RMB 3.3 billion and continues to grow its core diagnostic business steadily, with increasing international sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hotgen emphasizes its unique value through proprietary core technologies such as glycan capture for liquid biopsy, high-sensitivity chemiluminescence, and upconversion luminescence platforms, enabling highly sensitive, rapid, and automated diagnostic solutions. Its integrated approach from early screening to treatment, combined with AI-driven innovation and a broad product portfolio, differentiates it in the market. The company also highlights its quality management systems and strategic collaborations with top research institutions to sustain competitive advantages.
